description: Semver compare, version comparison and range check (npm semver). Compare two semantic versions (e.g. 1.2.3 vs 1.10.0-beta.1), check whether a version satisfies a range (^1.2, ~2.0, >=3 <4), or get the newest version from a list that satisfies a range. Uses npm's semver rules. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: semver_compare
